description: Source code for the class 'Coupon', a controller extension for handling coupon-related functionality in the OpenCart platform. Contains methods for displaying the coupon page and saving coupon data.

classes.name: Coupon
classes.description: Controller extension class for handling coupon operations like displaying the coupon form and saving coupon data in the checkout process.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the coupon page if the coupon total extension is enabled and passes data to the view template.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes the submitted coupon code, validates it, updates session data accordingly, and returns a JSON response indicating success or error.
